name: gruber-playout
description: FluxIO server-first desktop playout application powered by Node.js and FFmpeg

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @gruber/media-server && npm run build -w @gruber/web && npm run build -w @gruber/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test setup.test.mjs launch.test.mjs
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @gruber/media-server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @gruber/web
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @gruber/desktop && npm run dev -w @gruber/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run package -w @gruber/desktop
scripts.package:desktop:dir: npm run build && npm run package:dir -w @gruber/desktop
scripts.package:desktop:offline-dir: npm run build && npm run package:offline-dir -w @gruber/desktop
